theorems.name: Submission.lpf_pi_jacobian_local_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Tx : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Tx → ∀ v ∈ Tx, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t • v)) (L x v) 0) → ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), x ∈ K → ‖nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x)‖ ≤ C
